text:
deploy-bot: staged-rollout initiated: service=inference, version=v3.2.1 -> target=5% canary (global). rollout_id=r-2026-03-23-02. release-notes: https://git.redwood/release/v3.2.1

mira: @deploy-bot noted. I'll monitor latency tails and kv-cache evictions. :eyes:

joel: eu-west p99 creeping 210ms -> 245ms over last 4m, no 5xxs yet.

sam: ops opinion: hold further increases until cache behaviour understood. prefer keep at 5%.

alex: +1 hold. if it doesn't trend down in 10m, we'll pin eu-west back to v3.2.0.

deploy-bot: received. pausing any percent increase for rollout_id=r-2026-03-23-02. current percent=5%.

ops-bot: alert: kv-cache-evictions (eu-west) spiked 120/min -> 390/min. correlated to /v1/generate requests.

mira: likely eviction storm after warm cache fills. mitigation options: increase cache size (infra change, ~20m), tweak prefetch/batching config (~5m), or pin back.

joel: probing config tweak: reduce max_concurrent_prefetch=8 and raise kv_cache_threshold=0.7 on one canary host. command: `deployctl config set inference --env eu-west --key max_concurrent_prefetch --value 8`

joel: test host after tweak: p99 ~222ms (improved). still above baseline.

alex: decision: keep hold at 5% for 10m while tweak circulates. pin fallback if p99 > baseline+10% after 10m.

sam: prepping rollback playbook: https://confluence/redwood/rollback/r-2026-03-23-02 (drafting). pin command: `deployctl pin --env eu-west --service inference --version v3.2.0 --reason "kv-cache eviction spike"`

deploy-bot: will not progress rollout; will alert on automated rollback triggers.

ops-bot: automated rollback thresholds: 5xx-rate>0.5% OR p99>300ms for 3m. currently not triggered.

mira: adding known-issue blurb to release-notes noting eu-west kv-cache regression and recommended temp configs.

joel: will re-evaluate in 10m and post final go/no-go.

alex: reconvene in 10m or sooner on any new alerts. :thumbsup:

sam: change-window confirmed: 02:00-04:00 UTC, this is inside window.

deploy-bot: thread set to no-auto-escalate; manual updates allowed.

(ended)
